[SWS_SM_00703] Request satellites to leave Suspend Mode
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements:
RS_SM_00402
⌈
To leave the
Suspend Mode
,
ara::sm::s2r::S2RHub::RequestToLeaveSus-
pendMode
shall send a message to all actively registered
S2R Satellite
instances

ara::sm::s2r::S2RSatellite::LeaveSus-
pendMode
).
